summary: Iteration 2 - Worxpher fork 10-point fix verification. Backend: 6/6 pytest passed (root='Worxpher API', /auth/me is_admin true/false, /billing/cancel sets cancel_at_end, /shared/{token} 401 unauth + 200 auth non-owner, /admin/users/{id}/reset 200 admin (deletes reviews+annotations+comments verified via DB read), 403 non-admin, 404 unknown user). Dashboard paid-user subscription-card + cancel-plan flow VERIFIED WORKING (confirm dialog appears, confirm-cancel-plan click hits /api/billing/cancel and card updates to 'CANCELLED · ENDS ON EXPIRY' -- previously-recurring bug is FIXED). Pricing plan-free/creator/studio/business cards + upi-pay-panel with upi-qr, upi-deeplink, upi-app-gpay/phonepe/paytm all render on subscribe click. Admin Users tab shows 7 reset-user-{uid} buttons and nav-admin present in TopNav for admin. Workspace has workspace-edit-button/delete-button; edit dialog updates project title (verified), delete confirm navigates to /dashboard with 'Project deleted' toast. SharedReview page returns shared-auth-gate + shared-auth-login when unauthenticated (uses real share token to force 401). PDF export path exists for paid user (does NOT hit ad-lock-modal for creator plan; pdf-export-modal renders during capture loop but modal duration is ~1s for a single-comment review so we did not visually catch the transient modal in this run - source and logic verified correct).
